18 contributions

Awesome Family Lunch
Dec 2019 • Family
Our tour guide took us to this restaurant for lunch and it was amazing. Luckily they ordered for us as we probably wouldn’t have made the right choices. We had the famous pho cuon. It’s a fairly simple dish - beef, herbs and lettuce wrapped in the thick flat rice noodle - dipped in the fish sauce (optional for the kids). It was a lovely starter for our daughter who usually isn’t easily persuaded to try new foods. They were very yummy and we could have had more except our guide had ordered a lot of food. The deep fried corn was the daughter’s favourite snack to date. The highlight for the adults however, was the chicken and banana flower salad. Very well balanced dish, incredibly aromatic (read: fish sauce) and full of flavours and textures. Also had the deep fried rice noodles - which was dipped/filled with the beef and vegetables in the delicious gravy sauce. A bit heavy on the oil as it was deep fried so I wouldn’t be able to finish it on my own but definitely a must try share dish for the family. 

The entire meal, including drinks for the three of us was about 170 VND. Facilities appeared clean and the seats were well spaced apart and comfortable.

Hidden Pho Spot In Charming Neighborhood
Jul 2018 • Friends
We found this spot walking down the street from our Hotel. It was empty when we walked in, but quickly filled up afterwards…we must have beat the rush. First up the Pho Tron loved it, then the Pho Xao and My Xao loved them both. This is definitely a local spot, as we were the only foreigners there. They didn’t mind, they actually encouraged us to try more but we were stuffed. We also order a drink and rolls not pictured here. The total cost to feed 3 was only $10 USD.
